metric_scope: continuous = joint complete successes of all primary methods in the named dataset; separate nonmissing counts
rounding: Display does not change raw values; percentages two decimals, mm four decimals, provider microseconds two decimals
smoothness_definition: sqrt(mean_t ||(command_t-command_t-1)/(1/240 s)||_2^2), rad/s^2; initial mode switch/terminal stop excluded

validation_grid.selection_rule: Descending complete-success count, then ascending mean RMS tracking error among complete successes, then ascending predeclared grid index. Failure prefixes are retained but excluded from the tie-break metric. No test scores or PPO scores used.
validation_grid.validation_success_saturation_caveat: These validation scenarios do not distinguish candidates by success; the predeclared RMS tie-break selects weaker/shorter-range repulsion, without implying improved supplementary success
